description: Quality of life mod for dealing with villagers

releases.notes:
## NOTES:

- Make sure there are plenty of beds, if there aren't enough beds they won't breed.
- Throw stacks of bread at the villagers because they won't breed unless they have food.

## If you dont have the game, you can watch what the mod does here:

[![Watch the video](https://img.youtube.com/vi/B4F1q5PtNoY/hqdefault.jpg)](https://www.youtube.com/embed/B4F1q5PtNoY)

---

## Version & Dependencies

- Use Java 25
- Minecraft version 26.1.1
- Fabric loader version 0.18.6
- Fabric_api version 0.145.3+26.1.1

You can use whichever launcher you want, I recommend using Prism Launcher or the official Minecraft Launcher.

---

## Features

- This mod removes the timer for breeding for villagers, this will allow you to quickly start a villager breeder with only 2 villagers.

- You can carry villagers by pressing the “V” key. That way you don’t have to deal with boats and you don’t have to worry about villagers being attacked while you’re moving them. This will make starting a villager breeder faster too.

- You can convert “nitwit” villagers(villagers that don’t do any job) to normal villagers by giving them 1 emerald.
There are also particle effects for carrying and converting villagers too.
